queries: select supplier_id, date_trunc('week',order_date) wk, count(*) n, avg(is_delayed::int) delayed_rate, avg(delay_days) avg_delay, sum(quantity) q from supplier_delivery group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select p.supplier_id, date_trunc('week',b.date) wk, count(*) n from order_backorder b join product p on p.id=b.product_id group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select p.supplier_id, date_trunc('week',o.date) wk, count(*) n, sum(o.quantity*o.unit_price) rev from customer_order o join product p on p.id=o.product_id group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select date_trunc('week',date) wk, reason, count(*) n from complaint group by 1,2 order by 1,2
